chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Sa'id al-A'raj, who said:
I heard Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام saying: “A man may sleep while he is junub, and a woman may sleep while she is junub.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Aba 'Abdillah; title of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام in this narration
key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man; one subject of the ruling
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman; the other subject of the ruling
key_terms.جُنُبٌ: in a state of janabah; requiring ghusl due to major ritual impurity
key_terms.يَنَامُ: sleeps; indicates the act being discussed in the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sleep in the state of janabah before performing ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith states that it is permissible for both a man and a woman to sleep while in the state of janabah. It addresses a jurisprudential ruling related to ritual purity and indicates that immediate ghusl is not required before sleeping.
